race.comment: SENESCHAL (8) gets the nod after having clear excuses when beaten just over half a length by STREAK OF WINNING in a CL4 on the turf two weeks ago. He blundered at the start, raced wide throughout and still stayed close. Meets the winner a bit better at the weights and keeps Thompson. Can get the job done this time. STREAK OF WINNING (1) has to be respected off his win and suspect he has more to offer fourth-up, despite the weight rise. IKASARA (2) returns and boasts handy form lines from last prep. Is 1/1 over the track and trip and is aided at the weights with McColm's 3kg claim. Expect him to sit handy and make his presence felt, though he may be vulnerable late. CUESTA (12) has mixed her form this campaign and while she's drawn sticky, she warrants safe keeping in the minors.
